title: RawEvent
description: Input event consumed from Kafka topic `raw-events` (docs/CONTRACTS.md §1.1). This schema expresses STRICT_VALIDATION=true (the default): unknown top-level keys are rejected. With STRICT_VALIDATION=false use `$defs/lenient` instead, which is identical except that unknown top-level keys are allowed. Non-JSON or non-object input is invalid in both modes.

event_id.description: Producer-assigned event identifier. Becomes the Kafka key on `normalized-events`.

source.description: Logical producer of the event, e.g. `checkout-api`.

type.description: Event type. Defaults to `generic` when normalised.

component_id.description: Platform component the event concerns (see CONTRACTS.md §4).

payload.description: Arbitrary event body. Nested keys are never subject to strict validation.

isoOffsetDateTime.description: ISO-8601 / RFC 3339 date-time that carries an explicit offset (`Z` or `±HH:MM`). Local date-times without an offset are invalid.

lenient.description: RawEvent under STRICT_VALIDATION=false: same required fields and types, unknown top-level keys allowed (and dropped during normalisation).
